<mxfile host="Electron" agent="draw.io CLI"> <diagram id="state-model" name="判定层状态机"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1200" pageHeight="800" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="grpA" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;fillColor=none;verticalAlign=top;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#64748B;" value="前提层 · 命中即出，不再看下层" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="640" width="340" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="grpB" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;fillColor=none;verticalAlign=top;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#64748B;" value="链路层 · 前提全部通过后才谈" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="640" width="660" x="400" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#FEE2E2;strokeColor=#EF4444;fontColor=#991B1B;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="BLE_NotExist

fd≥3 / gd 60s / 20s 超时" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="290" x="580" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s8" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#DCFCE7;strokeColor=#22C55E;fontColor=#166534;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="Connected

id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="s5" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;whiteSpace=wrap;" target="s7" value="20s 超时"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
